item.title: Millsboro Man Dead after Single Vehicle Crash Near Georgetown
item.description: A Millsboro man is dead after a single vehicle crash on Zoar Road near Georgetown just after 5 Sunday evening. Delaware State Police say a pickup truck driven by 23 year old William Chilel-Ramirez of Millsboro was eastbound on Zoar Road west of Governor Stockley Road and failed to navigate a curve.
